description: M.S.B.S.M. Ajith Senanayake v. L.B. Finance Company M.S.B.S.M. Ajith Senanayake v. L.B. Finance Company View More before Hon. Anil Gooneratne, J.
parties: M.S.B.S.M. Ajith Senanayake v. L.B. Finance Company M.S.B.S.M. Ajith Senanayake v. L.B. Finance Company View More
keywords: The Appellant challenged the District Court’s order disallowing most of his claims to movable property seized in execution of a decree. Held - no statutory right of appeal existed against the claim inquiry order in terms of Section 247 of the Civil Procedure Code; the circumstances justified exercising revisionary jurisdiction to prevent a miscarriage of justice in terms of Article 138(1) of the Constitution. Appeal allowed with costs.
legistation: The Constitution of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka; Civil Procedure Code
